news.title: Dip buyers test whether Thursday's historic AI/chip selloff is over
news.text: Bloomberg and CNBC both report dip buyers stepping back into AI-linked names Friday after Thursday wiped out roughly $2.3T in market value and sent the Nasdaq into correction territory (-10% off its record close) on data-center buildout worries. CNBC's morning note flags Nasdaq futures clawing back some of the tech wreck; Bloomberg says chipmakers led the early bounce but investors are still weighing whether the rout is actually over.
